# Transit MCP

> Transit MCP is a free, anonymous, read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for real-time DC Metro and NYC Subway information. Transit MCP was formerly Metro MCP; it is the same server.

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://transitmcp.com/mcp
- Legacy endpoint, still supported: https://metro-mcp.anuragd.me/mcp
- Authentication: none. No login, API key, bearer token, or OAuth flow is required. Stale Authorization headers are ignored.
- Server description (JSON): https://transitmcp.com/info
- Works with Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, and any MCP client that speaks Streamable HTTP.
- ChatGPT plugin listing: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a9078f4d6dc8191be735cc1c2ff45b5

## Tool areas

- Arrivals: real-time train arrivals for DC Metro and NYC Subway stations, plus DC Metrobus stop predictions (`get_station_predictions`, `get_bus_predictions`).
- Incidents: service disruptions and DC Metro elevator and escalator outages (`get_incidents`, `get_elevator_incidents`).
- Stations: station search, listing by line, full station lists, and transfers (`search_stations`, `get_stations_by_line`, `get_all_stations`, `get_station_transfers`).
- Routes: NYC Subway route detail, DC Metrobus routes and stops (`get_route_info`, `get_bus_routes`, `get_bus_stops`).
- Live positions: DC Metro train positions and Metrobus vehicle positions (`get_train_positions`, `get_bus_positions`).

Data comes from official WMATA (DC Metro and Metrobus) and MTA (NYC Subway) feeds.

## Quick connect

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "transit-mcp": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://transitmcp.com/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

## Docs

- [Transit MCP docs](https://transitmcp.com/docs/): client setup, HTTP endpoints, MCP tools, resources and prompts, and data sources.
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/Aarekaz/metro-mcp): MIT licensed.

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://transitmcp.com/privacy/): how anonymous requests, operational telemetry, and provider logs are handled.
- [Terms of Use](https://transitmcp.com/terms/): fair use, rate limits, and live data limits.
- [Support](https://transitmcp.com/support/): documentation, issue reporting, maintainer contact, and security reports.
